name: openscreen
description: macOS assistant that answers questions about the window you are using.

scripts.build:runtime: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('runtime/dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p runtime/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:runtime-tests: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('runtime/dist-test', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p runtime/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test:runtime: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:runtime-tests && node --test "runtime/dist-test/tests/**/*.test.js"
